artworks.title: Cléo de Mérode
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on Japan paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman from the shoulders up, viewed in profile, positioned with her back slightly turned toward the viewer as she sits on a piece of furniture. Her head is turned slightly to the side, emphasizing her profile with subtly defined facial features. She has an extravagant, voluminous hairstyle that creates a dramatic silhouette. The woman is dressed in attire that includes a high, textured collar or scarf wrapped around her neck. In the background, there are sketches of two other figures sitting at a table, one reading a document. These figures are rendered with lighter, more minimal lines. The setting suggests an indoor environment, possibly a cafe or similar space, as indicated by the presence of furniture and the warm, intimate atmosphere created by the drawing's shading and line work.

artworks.title: Cléo de Mérode
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on China paper
artworks.description: The image features a sketched portrait of a seated woman in profile, facing to the right. She has intricate facial features with a pronounced nose and closed lips. Her hair is detailed and styled elaborately. She wears a large fur or feather garment on her shoulders. In the background, there are two faintly sketched figures at a table, with one holding a piece of paper. Soft background lines suggest curtains or walls.

artworks.title: Coquelin the Elder (Coquelin aine)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on Japan paper

The sketch shows curly hair, a large brimmed hat, and what appears to be a high-collared garment or scarf. There are no visible jewelry or objects in the person's hands. The background is minimally sketched with few strokes, creating a shadow-like effect. The image is monochrome with soft, flowing lines on a plain background.

artworks.title: Coquelin the Elder (Coquelin aine)

The person's hair or wig is suggested with curving lines. They appear to be wearing an outfit with a high collar or flowing fabric around the neck, indicated by loose, swirling lines. The background is minimal, with a few sketchy lines. The person is not wearing any visible jewelry or holding any objects. The style is loose and impressionistic, focusing on form over detail.

The person is wearing a high-collared garment with a checkered design and small circular details along the collar. There is no visible jewelry or objects in the person's hands. The background is plain with light shading. No jewelry, hands, or objects are visible.

artworks.title: Anna Held

The facial features are delicately sketched, with closed or gently narrowed eyes, slightly parted lips, and long, wavy hair blending with the background. The clothing is not distinctly outlined and blends into the shaded areas. The person's hand is near their mouth or chin in a thoughtful gesture. No visible jewelry is present. The background is abstract, with radiating lines above, suggestive of light or motion, and additional indistinct shapes and shading throughout the space.

artworks.title: Lender and Lavalliere in "Le fils de l'Aretin" (Lender et Lavallière dans "Le fils de l'Arétin")
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.description: This print shows two people, one made with dark lines, and one made with lighter, sketch-like lines. In the center is a person standing with their arms bent at the elbows, one hand holding a book and the other with a finger pointed upward. This person has a small nose, thin lips, short light-colored hair, and they are wearing a dark puff-sleeved dress with a high neck and textured skirt, along with a dark, flat hat. The person on the left is a ghostly outline, facing the right and looking upwards, with pale skin, faint features, and their hair in an updo. They also appear to wear a dress with a high neck and puffed sleeves. The background is light beige with some faint vertical streaks of light gray shading.

artworks.title: Supper in London (Souper à Londres)

artworks.description: The sketch shows three individuals at a table. The main focus is on a woman on the left and a man on the right. They are seated closely together. The woman has an upturned head with a calm expression, styled hair, and wears an elaborate outfit with floral details on her arms. The man has a clean face, slicked-back hair, and wears a high-collared garment. There is a third figure outlined behind them. A bottle is on the table in the bottom right. The background is subtly shaded with vertical strokes.

artworks.title: Supper in London (Souper à Londres)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black
artworks.description: The image is a pencil sketch showing three people, all depicted with their upper bodies only. The main focus is on two figures in the foreground, a man and a woman, seated closely. The woman is facing slightly to the left with her head turned upward. She has distinctive facial features, with a pronounced chin and lips, and her hair is styled in an updo. She is wearing a dress with ruffled details. The man next to her is turned slightly towards her, with delicate facial features and a calm expression. His hair is short, and he is dressed in a suit with a high collar. Both figures seem to be holding glasses, as suggested by their hand positions and what appears to be a bottle on the table in front of them. In the background, there is a lightly sketched third figure, a man standing and facing forward. The background is mostly filled with vertical lines and faint patterns, giving the impression of a textured environment.
